records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Works set up
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Ines explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:c3653fbf], after an onboarding call [calendar:5bd56af7] and two nudges [email:31d25ea3, email:177add52] produced no project, invite, or milestone. 8 days left, but stated intent is to pause evaluation, so unaided activation is unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the straight answer — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits your team. No pressure from me in the meantime.

One thing that usually makes the evaluation easier: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in Wrenfield tends to tell you more than anything else. If it's useful, I'm happy to help you set up that first project this week — just reply with a time and I'll walk through it with you, or answer questions by email if that's simpler.

Best,
Priya
